---
title: "winddata"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)


wind <- st_read("data/Wind_Speed_100m.geojson")

ggplot(wind) +
  geom_sf(aes(color = speed_mps), size = 0.6) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Wind Speed (m/s)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Wind Speed at 100m",
    subtitle = "Colored by wind speed (m/s)"
  )

```
